name: Foul Repercussion
source:
Challenged by his friends, this young boy stayed overnight at school and successfully overcame evil entities... or so he said. Little did he know, everything he told his friends is coming to reality. Will he manage to survive just like what he said in his lies?

[From [url=https://chaiyaworks.itch.io/foul-repercussion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在朋友们的挑战下，这个小男孩在学校过夜并成功战胜了邪恶实体……至少他是这么说的。他几乎不知道，他告诉朋友的一切都变成了现实。他能像他谎言中所说的那样活下来吗？
